verdict.rationale: Fellow documents natural-language questions about meetings through its own MCP server, for example "What did we decide in last month's standup?" This depends on an external AI assistant such as Claude or ChatGPT, and the native "Ask Fellow" feature appears only as a pricing line item. Missing for 10: answers with source citations or links back to meetings, explicit coverage of the whole meeting history, documentation of how native Ask Fellow works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can ask questions in natural language across my whole meeting history ("what did we decide about pricing?") and get answers with sources

citations.quote: Ask anything about your meetings - Get answers to questions like "What were my action items this week?" or "What did we decide in last month's standup?"
Fellow's Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server allows you to ask your AI Assistant about your meetings, without needing to write any code.
